headline: Nothing in the book changed overnight: the shares are fine, and the option clean-up is now two sessions from expiry.

points.label: Market context
points.text: 84% of the 215 F&O stocks have a green Supertrend, 23 are above RSI 70, no stock has flipped to green in the last 3 days, and 4 flipped red today. That is a mature uptrend: fresh entries are scarce, and the first red flips are appearing. Do not chase, and expect deployment to stay slow.

points.label: Versus the backtest
points.text: Max drawdown −0.4% against −21.3% tested, profit factor 1.56 against 1.75, winners +5.6% against +21.0%, losers −3.7% against −6.8%, holds 90d / 57d against 106d / 36d. All inside the tested range, but only because the book is 10 days old. Profit factor and average winner are the two to watch.

points.label: One sector carries the profit
points.text: Financial Services is 33% of the invested capital (13 positions) and made +₹13.7k, while every other sector together lost ₹1.3k. Nine of the 36 holdings are above RSI 70, mostly banks and lenders. TVSMOTOR alone is 13% of the book (about 6 times a normal position). A sector pullback would hit the whole profit at once.

points.label: Options: clean-up still open
points.text: The 4 stopped-out spreads are unchanged and still about ₹94k net down; Monday 23 Nov is expiry day, so only today and tomorrow are left to close them without physical settlement. Waiting has not helped in any of the last three checks.

points.label: Lock in what is working
points.text: Close CUMMINSIND (61% decayed), HINDZINC (Supertrend turned red since entry), PFC (ex-dividend window) and the 3 calls whose Supertrend flipped green. They are small profits that only turn into losses if the market keeps rising.

points.label: Advice status
points.text: Last night's advice (close the spreads, flipped calls, CUMMINSIND, HINDZINC, PFC at the open) is still open: the market has not opened yet. Nothing new has appeared since, so there is no new advice. The RVNL add-on is already pending as an after-market order, so do not place it again.

action: When the market opens, close the 4 stopped-out spreads first, then the 3 flipped calls, CUMMINSIND, HINDZINC and PFC. No new entries to chase and no rule to change.
